gross_exposure.definition: Sum of posted charge amounts for cases that are not closed.

net_exposure.definition: Gross exposure minus confirmed recoveries only; temporary credit and estimates are not deducted.

confirmed_recoveries.definition: Finalized credits on cases that are not closed.

temporary_credit.definition: Provisional credit issued and not yet finalized or reversed; never deducted from net exposure.

due_today.definition: Gross posted amounts of open cases due later today.

overdue.definition: Gross posted amounts of open cases past their due time.
